axis: 366-position month/day; Feb 29 (position 60) fed only by leap years — non-leap years are not_applicable, never a retrieval outage
dec3_note: years_active is computed in windows.json (DEC-3 provisional rule)
eligibility_rule: >= 60% of a year's CALENDAR-ERA days valid (era days = calendar days of the year inside the series span; partial years cannot pass as normal-year samples)

index.denominator_frozen_from: role=train days in the C-04 artifact (1012 days)
index.formula: idx(day) = log1p(published AOI FRP-sum) / log1p(P95 training daily reference MODIS FRP-sum)
index.raw_units_fallback: raw MW are always available in the accepted series

reference_note: MODIS is the reference measurement, not fire ground truth; index is AOI-specific and not comparable across regions
smoothing: circular ±7 days across the 366->1 seam (median curve)
